items.q: With Cliff would bring in something

ctx.x: The melody going into -- the get off part where everybody's playing -- all the saxophones, you know. Just saxophones.

We called that the million dollar reed section. This was some of the hardest things that, you know -- Everybody would bring in a chart. I would bring in something, With Cliff would bring in something, (inaudible). You could just send us something. Don
